messages:
maria: hi everyone  just landed today! quick question: where do folks post meeting notes vs action items vs quick product Qs? also my calendar is blowing up with bot reminders 😅

marta (People Ops): welcome maria! TL;DR: meeting notes -> link to a doc and post summary in the team channel (e.g., #eng-platform). Action items -> create a short thread or a ticket and post the link in-channel. Product questions -> #product or the feature-specific channel (e.g., #realtime-infra). Private HR stuff -> DM People Ops.

dan (Eng): for engineering meetings we usually create a Google Doc (or repo MD) and put the link as the root message, then keep follow-ups in-thread. If something needs an owner, add an action line like "@alice to do X by Wed" so notification rules fire.

rachel (Product): product: quick product clarifications in-channel are fine, but if it spawns design/acceptance convo start a new thread and link the doc/issue. We try to avoid long multi-topic threads in #product.

maria: helpful — thanks. calendar/bot noise: any recommended settings?

devex-bot: tip: To reduce calendar-bot pings, go to App Settings > Notifications and set "Only mentions" for calendar-bot. You can also `/calendar digest daily` to receive a single morning summary.

maria: nice. what about posting RFCs or design docs? public channel or private?

dan (Eng): RFCs -> post announcement in the relevant team channel + #eng (if cross-team). For very early drafts, ping 1-2 reviewers in DM to avoid noise. When ready for review, make it public and start a review thread.

rachel (Product): add: use the template in the handbook (link posted in #docs). Add a TL;DR at the top and list reviewers. That increases the chance folks will read.

marta (People Ops): small etiquette note: use threads for follow-ups, reactions for quick acks (:eyes:, :thumbsup:), and @channel sparingly (only for urgent/all-hands). If you're unsure which channel, ask here and we'll point it.

calendar-bot: [event] "Team Sync" today at 15:00 UTC - added to #eng-platform

maria: perfect — i'll post meeting notes with a doc link in #eng-platform and create action items as tickets, keep clarifying q's in #product. thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
